Giuliani objects to Mamdani attending 9/11 events; Mamdani responds

Former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani stated he was "offended" by the presence of academic Mahmood Mamdani at 9/11 memorial events in New York City. Giuliani suggested Mamdani should not attend these events. Mamdani subsequently responded to Giuliani's remarks. The specific nature of Mamdani's response and the exact details of the events were not provided in the coverage.
